sin.name: version-four-table-read-outside-a-move
sin.description: A version 4 table is read by name outside the move class of the module that owns its rows, so the base upgrade code or another module knows version 4's tables.
sin.rule: Read a version 4 table only in a VersionFourMove in the upgrade/ folder of the module that owns the rows; the runner and the base classes name no table.
